page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre with page number at top right; a large astronomical diagram (concentric circles with zodiac signs and labels) occupies the upper part; below it one block of running text in italic, ending with a centred line; the last line "SYSTE-" is a catchword-like hyphenated word at lower right of the text block. No margin notes.

p.i: Nos hic priorem Astronomiæ partem atque adeo etiam doctrinam de Planetis Deo benedicente finimus, & id iterum toronidis loco monemus, quod & doctus Astronomus Adrianus Metius in suo libello sphærico monet, doctrinam de primo mobili plurimum habere certitudinis & esse magna ex parte ab artificibus absolutam, doctrinam autem de Planetis sive inferioribus mobilibus, & incertitudine passim & perplexitate non exigua laborare, ac vehementer desiderare sive Copernicii sive Tychonem, qui præstantissimam rem & humana cognitione dignissimam ad maiorem quandam certitudinem, expeditiorem perspicuitatem, ac dexteriorem methodum reformet.

page.notes: The diagram is an astronomical figure with concentric rings, zodiac signs, numerals 1–12 and labels "c.d. deferentis", "c. æquantis", "c. mundi", "DEFERENS ECCENT", "DEFERENS AVGEM." It is not transcribed as text. The last word "SYSTE-" is a line-end hyphenated word and is printed at the foot of the text block; it is not a true heading.
